bio: Knightsbridge Hotel is situated on a quiet tree-lined street, in the heart of Knightsbridge.  Once three Victorian townhouses, the hotel's impressive pillared and porticoed entrance, leads you into interiors that have been created by owner Kit Kemp, famous for her eclectic and colourful designs.  Afternoon Tea is served in The Library, with book lined walls, bold fabrics and modern art. Kit Kemp's design even extends to the Afternoon Tea crockery. The distinctive 'Mythical Creatures' is based on her original embroidered fabric design.  The Afternoon Tea menu features and assortment of finger sandwiches along with a Borage and ricotta tart and Seaweed scone with a lobster mayonnaise.  Scones are served with clotted cream and preserves, followed by the desserts, which include Black Forest gâteau, Strawberry Eton Mess tart and Rose and pistachio polenta cake. Add a glass of Pommery Brut NV Champagne for a special occassion.  Knightsbridge Hotel is just a short walk from Harvey Nichols, Harrods and the Victoria & Albert Museum.  Afternoon Tea costs £40 per person or £52 with a glass of Pommery Champagne.  Please note that each guest dining must order Afternoon Tea. One Afternoon Tea cannot be shared between two or more guests.
